entries.claim: A skill is a directory containing at minimum a SKILL.md file, with optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ subdirectories.
entries.source_quote_he: A skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a SKILL.md file:

entries.claim: The frontmatter requires exactly two fields, name and description. name is max 64 characters, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens only, must not start or end with a hyphen.
entries.source_quote_he: name	Yes	Max 64 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must not start or end with a hyphen.

entries.claim: description is required, max 1024 characters, non-empty.
entries.source_quote_he: description	Yes	Max 1024 characters. Non-empty. Describes what the skill does and when to use it.

entries.claim: compatibility is an optional frontmatter field, max 500 characters, for environment requirements.
entries.source_quote_he: compatibility	No	Max 500 characters. Indicates environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access, etc.).

entries.claim: metadata is an optional first-class frontmatter field: a map from string keys to string values for properties the spec does not define.
entries.source_quote_he: metadata	No	Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata (a map from string keys to string values).

entries.claim: assets/ is a documented optional directory for templates, images and data files such as lookup tables.
The documented budgets are: SKILL.md under 500 lines, and instructions loaded on activation under 5000 tokens.
entries.source_quote_he: Keep your main SKILL.md under 500 lines. Move detailed reference material to separate files.

entries.claim: Resources in scripts/, references/ and assets/ are loaded only when required, which is the progressive-disclosure model.
entries.source_quote_he: Resources (as needed): Files (e.g. those in scripts/, references/, or assets/) are loaded only when required

entries.claim: In Claude Code a personal skill is installed by placing it at ~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md; there is no separate install command.
entries.source_quote_he: Create a directory for the skill in your personal skills folder. Personal skills are available across all your projects.

entries.claim: The personal skill location is ~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md and applies across all projects on that machine.
entries.source_quote_he: Personal	~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md	All your projects on this machine, but not Cowork or cloud sessions

entries.claim: name must not contain consecutive hyphens.
name must match the parent directory name.
entries.source_quote_he: Must match the parent directory name

entries.claim: Instructions loaded on activation are recommended to stay under 5000 tokens.
entries.source_quote_he: Instructions (< 5000 tokens recommended): The full SKILL.md body is loaded when the skill is activated

entries.claim: File references should stay one level deep from SKILL.md.
entries.source_quote_he: Keep file references one level deep from SKILL.md. Avoid deeply nested reference chains.

entries.claim: allowed-tools is an optional, experimental frontmatter field taking a space-separated string of pre-approved tools.
entries.source_quote_he: allowed-tools	No	Space-separated string of pre-approved tools the skill may use. (Experimental)

entries.claim: The specification ships a reference validator invoked as skills-ref validate ./my-skill.
